Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis Report

Resample Ablation Method: This analysis applies resample ablation to identify critical attention heads for subject-verb number agreement. Resample ablation replaces a component's output with an activation obtained from a randomly sampled prompt. This ensures the model receives data that is both normal (proper activation distribution) and independent of context. This method tests robustness by averaging results across multiple random samples.
